reason: Both key builders emit `namespace + ".perm_" + userUID + "_" + action…` (pkg/services/authz/rbac/cache.go:27 and :31), both wrappers share one cache, and Name/ParentFolder are unvalidated (service.go:226-227), so the key spaces are not disjoint. A collision needs contrived input (a user UID like `u1_dashboards:read_dash1` plus a parent folder equal to an action string), and the bool-vs-map JSON mismatch makes a collided read fail to unmarshal and count as a miss (cache.go:70-74), not a wrong decision.
